description: Average monthly rent of studio units in privately initiated rental apartment structures of three or more units in the October 2025 CMHC Rental Market Survey (all units, occupied and vacant-for-rent; sitting tenants included).
basis: average rent charged, purpose-built rental apartments (3+ units), October survey

comparabilityNote: CPI measures price change over time, not price levels: do not use it to rank which place is cheaper. Published for provinces and selected cities only; other places show their province's value (flagged provincial_value).

description: 12-month percentage change in the Consumer Price Index for rented accommodation (rent and closely related tenant costs) - how fast rents already being paid by tenants are rising. City series where StatCan publishes one, otherwise provincial.
basis: CPI (2002=100), not seasonally adjusted, price change not price level
